newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Dec 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Dec 11.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Paris mayor Jean Tiberi said by witness to have negotiated his wife's salary for an allegedly bogus report written for Essonne local authority.
-- Conservative majority parliamentarians accept Senate amendment planning to reduce wealth tax for high-income taxpayers.
-- German chemicals group Hoechst launches buyout offer for minority stakes in Roussel Uclaf, of which it already holds 56.53 percent, at 1530 francs per share.
-- Arms group Giat Industries reaches agreement on shorter work week, reducing planned job cuts linked to defence sector restructuring by around 700 posts.
-- Carrefour buys 33.34 percent of GMB company, which controls Groupe Cora hypermarkets, creating largest French retail group.
-- Finance Minister Jean Arthuis postpones to early 1997 a decision on Credit Foncier.
